Heidy Pino is a successful Cuban-American model and social media influencer who has gained significant recognition in the fashion and beauty industry. Born in Havana, Cuba, she moved to Miami, Florida with her family at a young age in pursuit of better opportunities.

Pino began her modeling career in her late teens after being discovered by a local talent scout at a Miami shopping mall. She quickly gained attention for her striking features and photogenic presence, leading to collaborations with various fashion brands and photographers.

Her breakthrough came when she signed with Elite Model Management in 2014, which helped her secure campaigns with notable brands like Forever 21 and American Eagle. Pino has also graced the covers of several Latin American fashion magazines, including Venue Magazine and Ocean Drive en Español.

In recent years, Pino has expanded her influence through social media, particularly Instagram, where she has amassed a significant following. She frequently shares fashion, lifestyle, and beauty content with her audience. She has also ventured into business, launching her own swimwear line called "Luna Mar" in 2019, which has become particularly popular in South America.

Beyond modeling, Pino has worked with various charitable organizations, particularly those focused on supporting Cuban immigrant communities in Florida. She has also appeared in several music videos for prominent Latin artists and was featured in Pitbull's 2018 world tour as a principal dancer.

In 2020, she became the first Cuban-American model to walk the runway for Victoria's Secret's annual fashion show, marking a significant milestone in her career. She currently splits her time between Miami and New York City, continuing to work on major fashion campaigns while developing her personal brand through various entrepreneurial ventures.
